newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Trans Tasman consolidates bank debt.
newsitem.headline: Trans Tasman consolidates bank debt.

text.p: Trans Tasman Properties said on Wednesday it had refinanced all group bank debt with a single NZ$387 million five-year facility from a consortium of five banks.
The company's consolidated bank debt had been reduced to 35 percent of property assets from 51 percent, Trans Tasman said in a statement.
Trans Tasman said it had applied $178 million of the $190 million it received from the listing of subsidiary Australian Growth Properties (AGP) last month to bank debt repayment.
Of the balance, $10.1 million went to issue costs and $1.9 million was retained as working capital.
TTP retains a 41 percent interest in AGP.
